audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart contradicted its own prose. win[]/phases[].side gave Level 1 to Irelia, Level 3 to Tahm Kench and First item to Tahm Kench, while whys[0] says Level 1 is his, whys[2] says Level 3 is your first real burst window and whys[5] calls first item your one clean snowball window. The packet levelChart agrees with the prose.
audit.why: Rows 0, 2 and 5 rendered the opposite answer to the text under them.
audit.corrected: Row 0 -> Tahm Kench, row 2 -> Irelia, row 5 -> Irelia, proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes attributed Tahm Kench's shield and escape to the wrong slots: spikes[1] called his W a 'self-Devour', and spikes[0]/spikes[2] credited a 'grey health passive'.
audit.why: W is Abyssal Dive (leap + knockup, 21/20/19/18/17s). The stored-damage shield is Thick Skin (E, 3s cooldown). Devour (R) targets a champion, never himself.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name Abyssal Dive as the 21s exit, Thick Skin as the 3s shield cash-in, and Ionian Fervor stacks as the on-hit spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three kit errors: (a) 'grey health passive' — his passive is An Acquired Taste (stacking mark; third Tongue Lash stuns), the damage-store shield is Thick Skin (E); (b) 'W self-Devour' — W is Abyssal Dive, a dive/knockup reposition; (c) 'R (Abyssal Voyage)' in breakdown late/wants.foe[2] — his R is Devour, and Abyssal Voyage is not in the live kit.
audit.why: Riot text in the kit file names Q Tongue Lash (7/6.5/6/5.5/5s, 900 range, stuns at 3 An Acquired Taste stacks), W Abyssal Dive (21/20/19/18/17s, knockup), E Thick Skin (3s, stored damage to shield), R Devour (champion target, damage or ally shield).
audit.corrected: Also corrected on Irelia's side per the mirror: Ionian Fervor is attack speed and bonus on-hit at max stacks, with no armour shred anywhere in the kit — every 'armor shred' reference removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown text said 'his escape + shield' with no numbers and merged two different abilities.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive is 21s at rank 1 and is his only reposition; Thick Skin is up every 3s and is never a fight-gating cooldown.
audit.corrected: Track Abyssal Dive (21s rank 1) as the engage gate; treat Thick Skin as constant and bait it instead of timing it.

audit.why: The missing-interaction rule 'needs-antiheal' is already served: report[8] calls for Executioner's Calling early against his healing.

edits.before: Level 1 is his — Tahm Kench just walks up, eats a couple of my autos and stores them as grey health via his passive (An Acquired Taste), so I don't waste my only Q dash trying to trade a tank who regenerates it instantly. I farm with Bladesurge resets off the wave and respect his Q (Tongue Lash): the ramped tongue is a long-range stun that can lock me before my E ever lands. At Level 3 my E (Flawless Duet) blades come online and I get my first real combo — but only commit when his Q is down, or the tongue stun cancels my dash mid-air.
edits.after: Level 1 is his — Tahm Kench walks up, eats a couple of my autos and banks them into Thick Skin (E), a shield he can cash every 3 seconds, so I don't waste my only Q dash on a tank who gets it straight back. I farm with Bladesurge resets off the wave and respect his Q (Tongue Lash, 7s at rank 1, 900 range): every hit stacks An Acquired Taste, and the third one stuns me before my E ever lands. At Level 3 my E (Flawless Duet) blades come online for my first real combo — but commit only when his Q is down, or that stun cancels my dash mid-air.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 favour his sustain — my passive armor-shred ramps the longer I stick on him, but his grey health and percent-HP regen quietly out-last it in any drawn-out fight, so I want short E-stun bursts, not extended duels. Level 6 is my real swing: Vanguard's Edge answers a champion who otherwise self-Devours with W or Flashes out of my dive. Wall the escape behind him, E-stun in, and burst before he can reposition. Bait his Q tongue first — if he throws Tongue Lash on cooldown, I get a free window with no stun to break my reset chain.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 favour his sustain — my attack speed ramps the longer I stick on him, but Thick Skin and the heal on Tongue Lash quietly out-last it in any drawn-out fight, so I want short E-stun bursts, not extended duels. Level 6 is my real swing: Vanguard's Edge answers a champion who otherwise leaps clear with Abyssal Dive (W, 21s) or Flashes out of my dive. Wall the escape behind him, E-stun in, and burst before he repositions. Bait his Q first — a whiffed Tongue Lash is 7 seconds with no stun to break my reset chain.

edits.before: At two items he reclaims the lane — a full drain-tank build plus grey health means he face-tanks my entire combo and shrugs off the armor I shred, while one ramped Q tongue stun mid-Bladesurge flips any all-in into his kill. I stop trying to solo him and convert my mid-game windows into objectives and a lead elsewhere. Watch his R (Abyssal Voyage) — he'll channel out of lane to swing onto another fight, so I shove the wave and punish the map rather than the unkillable tank in front of me.
edits.after: At two items he reclaims the lane — a full drain-tank build plus Thick Skin means he face-tanks my entire combo, while one 3-stack Tongue Lash stun mid-Bladesurge flips any all-in into his kill. I stop trying to solo him and convert my mid-game windows into objectives and a lead elsewhere. Watch his R (Devour): he swallows the carry I jumped on, or shields an ally out of my Vanguard's Edge wall, so I shove the wave and punish the map rather than the tank in front of me.

notes: Three kit-name errors were shipped on this page and are now corrected: (1) a 'grey health passive' that does not exist — the stored-damage shield is Thick Skin (E, 3s), while the passive An Acquired Taste is the 3-stack mark whose third Tongue Lash stuns; (2) 'W self-Devour' — W is Abyssal Dive, a leap/knockup reposition on 21/20/19/18/17s, and Devour (R) can only target a champion, never himself; (3) 'R (Abyssal Voyage)' in breakdown.late and wants.foe[2], an ability not in the live kit at all. Per the mirror, Irelia's Ionian Fervor is attack speed plus bonus on-hit at max stacks with NO armour shred, so every 'armor shred' claim was removed. dontsFull[1].t still reads 'Fight into his W reactivate' — Abyssal Dive has no reactivate; the string is under the applier's 25-character floor so it was left alone and needs a manual fix. Level chart rows 0/2/5 disagreed with their own prose and with packet.levelChart; proposed as matched full+content pairs.
